digest.component_or_area: BindingStore rich-emission facade and apply_handlers integration
propositions: Production rich-emission state mutation reaches bindings through all_bindings() query instead of the narrow BindingStore.note_rich_emit facade method.
The call site docstring falsely claims binding_store.py sits at module-size cap and cannot carry a narrower accessor, but S2 T3 added such an accessor and the file is no longer at capacity.
Rich-emission routing must use the authoritative facade operation without changing hashes, counters, fail-open behavior, logs, or publication, preserving exact backward compatibility.

A production census test must prevent any mutation of bindings through all_bindings() while allowing legitimate read-through callers (binding_walk, reconcile_helpers, reconcile_check, _commands/bridge_repair).
ADR 0099 lacks finalized details on realized recovery boundary, reversal rules, explicit-unretire mechanism, and the prohibition on broad tickets-branch staging.
